item.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
item.description: The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.

item.title: As UN Secretary General's last day approaches, search for his replacement continues
item.description: The UN Secretary General's term ends this year, but the big powers at the UN have been unable to agree on a replacement. UN watchers worry that there will be little time to get up to speed.
item.content:encoded: The UN Secretary General's term ends this year, but the big powers at the UN have been unable to agree on a replacement. UN watchers worry that there will be little time to get up to speed.

item.title: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and deputy secretary of state, has died
item.description: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as deputy secretary of state under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday. He was 80.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
item.description: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

item.title: How American Thanksgiving took root — and evolved — in Liberia
item.description: The first settlers of Liberia were African Americans who brought along the holiday of Thanksgiving — which has evolved to reflect the history and identity of this new nation.
